title: Spin singlets are useful
summary: We evaluate the utility of the spin-zero manifold of an exchange-coupled array of $N$ spins for tasks in quantum computation and quantum simulation. Since pairs of electrons can be readily initialized into a product state of singlets in semiconducting quantum dot arrays, the full spin-zero manifold is available with exchange-only control, providing a Hilbert space of approximate dimension $2^N/(N/2)^{3/2}$, asymptotically close to the $2^N$ dimension of the full spin Hilbert space.
